notes: GPUI WIDGETS. The target UI framework is GPUI 0.2.2 (Zed's framework), not React. You have no training knowledge of this exact API, so read before writing: rever/src/main.rs (the app shell: how views, listeners, hover and theme are used here), every file in rever-ui-kit/src (theme tokens, icons, strings via `Lang::t`, preview::run), vendor/gpui/examples/*.rs and vendor/gpui/src/elements/*.rs (look at `deferred`, `anchored` and `overlay`-style elements for popups, and at on_mouse_down_out for closing them). What to build: view structs or element builders that reproduce each React component's layout, sizes, colors and behaviors: a popup menu (the `.chrome-menu` / `.chrome-menu-item` / `.chrome-menu-sep` styles: items with a label, optional hint, optional submenu or checked state, separators, a footer line, closing on outside click or Escape), a chip-style select with its dropdown, toasts that appear and dismiss themselves after the same delays, the IP badge with its hidden/shown/refresh states, and the bot-check button. Things the React code does over IPC (`window.rev.*`: fetching the egress IP, copying, page events) are taken as trait objects or closure arguments so the host can supply them later; the preview supplies fakes. Colors and sizes come from src/renderer/src/styles.css tokens (in rever_ui_kit::theme::Theme; if a token is missing, define it locally and list it in your report). All user-facing strings go through `rever_ui_kit::i18n::Lang::t(key)` with the same keys the TSX uses. Keep logic in plain functions with Korean-named unit tests; a .tsx gets the `Port of` marker only when its behaviors are all there. Preview: fill examples/preview.rs so `cargo run -p rever-ui-menus --example preview_menus` shows every widget, with the menu and the select open (use rever_ui_kit::preview::run). Look at your own work: while it runs, `scripts/capture-window.sh preview_menus /tmp/preview_menus.png` captures only that window; read the PNG, compare with what the TSX would render, fix what is off. Do not bring windows to the front, do not capture the screen any other way, and do not run the `rever` app. The first build of a GPUI crate takes a few minutes.
